instruction: Navigate to the latest discussions page on FlightAware community forums.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to FlightAware discussions and viewing the latest discussions page. Similar interaction pattern to the original task (navigate discussions, apply filter/sort criterion, view results). Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (get_active_tab_info and is_expected_active_tab) to verify the latest discussions page is opened.
metadata.similarity_justification: Same website (FlightAware discussions), same interaction pattern (navigate discussions, apply sorting/filtering), same difficulty level. Only difference is viewing the latest topics list instead of finding a specific topic by reply count.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction: The instruction asks to 'Navigate to the latest discussions page' (not to open a specific discussion), and the evaluator checks for the URL 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/latest' which is exactly the latest discussions page
Getter logic is correct: get_active_tab_info extracts the active tab URL from accessibility tree and returns it as a dict with 'url' key
Metric logic is correct: is_expected_active_tab receives the active_tab_info dict, extracts the 'url' field, and compares it with the expected URL using compare_urls function
Expected value is semantically correct: The URL 'https://discussions.flightaware.com/latest' is the correct URL for the FlightAware latest discussions page as requested in the instruction
Complete coverage: The evaluator checks the only requirement in the instruction - that the user navigates to the latest discussions page
